name: Exponential Weight Tie-Breaker Obfuscation
description: Rewords the "lexicographically smallest" tie-breaker as minimizing a base-2 polynomial sum. Models relying on surface pattern matching will misinterpret this as a weighted optimization problem (e.g., DP or max-cut) and fail, while models that reason about the structure will realize it is exactly equivalent to lexicographical order and solvable via standard bipartite component coloring.
